summary: Iter-22 Cursor Effects Engine tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 9 backend pytest tests pass and every frontend acceptance criterion verified — including all 10 effects painting non-zero alpha pixels, hover preview, click persistence across reload, None removing canvas, per-tenant override on public preview, and admin's personal effect restoring after leaving preview. No regressions observed (base cursor-dot/cursor-ring still render, no console/page errors from the canvas engine).
critical_code_review_comments: cursorEffects.js startCursorFX reads window.innerWidth/innerHeight directly and depends on `matchMedia` in CursorFX.jsx guard — SSR-safe today because it only runs in useEffect, but any future SSR/pre-render pipeline should re-check.

particle cap MAX=260 is global, not per-effect; heavy effects (comet spawns 3/sample) can starve lighter ones on rapid mouse movement — acceptable but consider per-effect budgets if perf regressions surface.
PATCH /me/preferences silently ignores unknown keys; if the endpoint is later extended, add explicit key allowlist to avoid drift.
